question: In a certain code language, ‘JAM’ is written as ‘KCP’ and ‘MUG’ is written as ‘NWJ’. How will ‘TEA’ be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15d4e688c8bdc2766cb74c67a7c0d12a85a1e60bc448f376b860b7949a5ae586.png] 

The logic followed here is:

‘JAM’ is written as ‘KCP’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5e03e302539e8286843b2307f090ddd22b3ac2996cd0f2a4881fdad1b7cc7020.png] 

And,

‘MUG’ is written as ‘NWJ’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/570d614a97c14fb9aa48af69cc9ce021bfa802fd84e1d2ba68999ec53381fa5e.png] 

Similarly,

‘TEA’ is written as

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/851a325140e326257eeea91a63bfd0a58495ab5083eb721f4132884a9aa809c4.png] 

Hence, "Option 1" is the correct answer.
